name: Coin Flip
summary: Coin Flip is a simple scalping EA that uses a probabilistic coin-flip approach to determine trade direction, entering buy or sell positions randomly on each new bar. It applies basic stop loss and take profit levels with optional lot sizing, making it essentially a random entry system with fixed risk-reward management. The EA serves as a baseline or experimental tool rather than a strategy-driven trading system.
summary_zh: Coin Flip是一个简单的剥头皮EA，使用概率性的抛硬币方式来决定交易方向，在每个新K线上随机进入买入或卖出仓位。它应用基本的止损和止盈水平以及可选的手数设置，本质上是一个随机入场配合固定风险回报管理的系统。该EA更像是一个基准测试或实验工具，而非策略驱动的交易系统。
strategy_analysis: Coin Flip EA的核心策略概念是基于随机概率决定交易方向，类似于抛硬币——每个新K线生成时，EA随机选择做多或做空。入场条件为新K线形成时随机生成方向信号，没有任何技术指标或价格行为分析作为过滤。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设置，没有移动止损或其他动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可以设定初始手数大小。资金管理方面缺乏基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位调整，仅依赖静态止损来控制单笔风险。整体策略缺乏趋势判断、波动率过滤和市场状态识别，属于纯随机入场系统。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of Coin Flip EA is based on random probability to determine trade direction, similar to flipping a coin — on each new bar, the EA randomly selects to go long or short. Entry conditions are simply a new bar formation with a randomly generated direction signal, without any technical indicator or price action analysis as a filter. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit settings, with no trailing stop or other dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user can set the initial lot size. Money management lacks dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage, relying solely on static stop loss to control per-trade risk. The overall strategy lacks trend identification, volatility filtering, and market state recognition, making it a purely random entry system.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 代码结构简洁，易于理解和修改，适合作为学习EA编程的入门范例
固定止损止盈提供了明确的风险控制边界，防止单笔亏损无限扩大
随机入场系统可作为基准对照，用来验证其他策略是否真正优于随机
实现简单，对系统资源消耗极低，适合长时间运行
魔术编号机制确保订单识别准确，不会与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Clean code structure, easy to understand and modify, suitable as an introductory example for learning EA programming
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide clear risk control boundaries, preventing unlimited single-trade losses
Random entry system can serve as a benchmark to validate whether other strategies truly outperform randomness
Simple implementation with minimal system resource consumption, suitable for long-term operation
Magic number mechanism ensures accurate order identification without conflict with other EAs
cons: 策略完全基于随机入场，没有任何市场分析或技术指标过滤，长期期望值趋近于零
缺乏资金管理机制，不会根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整仓位大小
没有移动止损功能，无法在盈利时锁定利润，容易将浮盈变为亏损
未考虑点差和佣金成本，在剥头皮场景下交易成本可能吞噬大部分利润
没有交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性或高波动时段产生不利交易
cons_en: Strategy is entirely based on random entry without any market analysis or technical indicator filtering, long-term expected value approaches zero
Lacks money management mechanism, does not dynamically adjust position size based on account balance or risk ratio
No trailing stop function, unable to lock in profits during winning trades, easily turning floating gains into losses
Does not account for spread and commission costs, which in scalping scenarios could consume most of the profit
No trading session filter, may generate unfavorable trades during low liquidity or high volatility periods
improvements: 增加技术指标过滤条件（如均线方向、RSI超买超卖）来提高入场质量，避免纯随机交易
加入基于账户风险的动态仓位管理，根据止损距离和风险比例自动计算手数
增加移动止损和保本止损功能，在交易盈利时保护利润
添加交易时段过滤和点差检查，避免在不利的交易条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add technical indicator filters (such as MA direction, RSI overbought/oversold) to improve entry quality and avoid pure random trading
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk, automatically calculating lot size from stop loss distance and risk ratio
Add trailing stop and break-even stop functions to protect profits when trades are in profit
Add trading session filter and spread check to avoid opening positions under unfavorable trading conditions

risk_points: 纯随机入场没有任何市场依据，长期交易结果完全依赖运气而非策略优势
固定手数不随账户变化，在连续亏损时可能导致账户资金快速消耗
未检查点差和交易成本，在剥头皮模式下可能频繁产生负期望交易
risk_points_en: Pure random entry has no market basis, long-term trading results depend entirely on luck rather than strategic edge
Fixed lot size does not adapt to account changes, consecutive losses could rapidly deplete account funds
No spread or trading cost check, scalping mode may frequently generate negative-expectancy trades
